_routing_note: When k8s_defer_to_coordinator is true and a K3s coordinator is active, the K8S.20 distribute_tests formula owns the actual per-machine shard split and these static machine weights are IGNORED. Fail-CLOSED policy: heavy quality runs 100% on Dell via the docker_context transport; Windows (MSI) does 0% and never absorbs Dell's work. If Dell is unreachable the gate hard-fails with a 'fix Dell' message — MSI runs nothing locally. Mint is the storage/observability host, never a compute shard. Windows (MSI) is not a quality host: it appears in NO machine list (machines, coverage, lint, or pytest) and the ssh and docker_local transports are not supported by the turbo mutation coordinator. Fail-CLOSED: if Dell is unreachable the gate hard-fails with 'fix Dell' — MSI does NOT measure locally. The pass/fail semantics are unchanged — only WHERE each file's coverage is measured.

Dell lints 100% of the changed Python files; Windows 0%. Fail-CLOSED: if Dell is unreachable the gate hard-fails with 'fix Dell' — MSI does NOT lint locally. Pass/fail semantics are unchanged — only WHERE each file is linted.

Dell runs 100% of the changed test targets; Windows runs none and is not listed.
